verses.text: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
lines: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler.
Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

verses.text: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
lines: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion.
He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

verses.text: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
lines: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife,
but every fool will be quarreling.

verses.text: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
lines: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter;
therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

verses.text: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
lines: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water,
but a man of understanding will draw it out.

verses.text: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
lines: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love,
but who can find a faithful man?

verses.text: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
lines: A righteous man walks in integrity.
Blessed are his children after him.

verses.text: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
lines: A king who sits on the throne of judgment
scatters away all evil with his eyes.

verses.text: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
lines: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure.
I am clean and without sin?”

verses.text: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
lines: Differing weights and differing measures,
both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

verses.text: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
lines: Even a child makes himself known by his doings,
whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

verses.text: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
lines: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye,
Yahweh has made even both of them.

verses.text: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
lines: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty.
Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

verses.text: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
lines: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer;
but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

verses.text: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
lines: There is gold and abundance of rubies,
but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

verses.text: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
lines: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger;
and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

verses.text: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
lines: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man,
but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

verses.text: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
lines: Plans are established by advice;
by wise guidance you wage war!

verses.text: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
lines: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets;
therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

verses.text: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
lines: Whoever curses his father or his mother,
his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

verses.text: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
lines: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning,
won’t be blessed in the end.

verses.text: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
lines: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.”
Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.

verses.text: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
lines: Yahweh detests differing weights,
and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

verses.text: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
lines: A man’s steps are from Yahweh;
how then can man understand his way?

verses.text: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
lines: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication,
then later to consider his vows.

verses.text: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
lines: A wise king winnows out the wicked,
and drives the threshing wheel over them.

verses.text: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
lines: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp,
searching all his innermost parts.

verses.text: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
lines: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe.
His throne is sustained by love.

verses.text: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
lines: The glory of young men is their strength.
The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

verses.text: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
lines: Wounding blows cleanse away evil,
and beatings purge the innermost parts.
